title: Security: non-ephemeral self-hosted runner (jta-infra, trainer VM) on a public repo; fork-PR approval setting unread
note: REPO READ 2026-11-11: infra-runner-smoke.yml:32 runs on [self-hosted, jta-infra]; system-actions, trainer-vm-diag, vm-diag-snapshot and diag-relay-sweep switch to it when vars.INFRA_RUNS_ON is set. The runner is installed on the trainer VM, which holds the SSH key into the live VM. No --ephemeral flag. infra-runner-install.yml:92-95 only READS the fork-PR approval policy. Risk: on a public repo a fork PR that edits a pull_request workflow can target the runner label. UNVERIFIED: the repo's fork-PR approval setting, the runner group's public-repo setting, whether INFRA_RUNS_ON is armed now. First step is reading those three settings (needs the admin token).
